findings: The engine warning measures the whole game-mode Think callback. Neighboring log messages do not identify its most expensive task.

Scheduler scans every pending task each 50 ms, including future deadlines. Indexed deadline heap now examines only the earliest deadline and due tasks, with immediate removal for cancelled/replaced IDs.

Multiple attacks on one target scheduled redundant UNIT_COMBAT_STATS_CHANGED publications. A stable per-target ID now publishes the latest result once per scheduler batch; every armor hit still applies immediately.

Several detailed logs ignored the existing runtime_detailed_diagnostics=0 flag. These logs, diagnostic field allocations/model reads and native armor reads are now guarded. Failure logs and damage numbers remain.
